verdict.rationale: Motion documents recurring tasks: you can create daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly tasks and it blocks calendar time for them automatically. It also advertises an AI Workflow Builder and Zapier connectivity. However, these recurring items are human to-dos placed on a calendar, not automated jobs that execute on a schedule. Nothing shows that workflows can run on a recurring trigger, natively or via the API. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring execution of automated workflows, API support for recurrence, detailed recurrence configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
